scripts.e2e:parity: PLAYWRIGHT_PARITY_GATE=1 RELEASE_GATE_CI=1 playwright test tests/e2e/wiki-comment-flow.spec.ts --grep "desktop/mobile parity fixture matrix" --reporter=line
scripts.gate:leak: RELEASE_GATE_CI=1 uv run pytest ../backend/tests/test_workspace_sync.py::test_v2_mode_keeps_annotations_isolated_from_content_outputs_with_unicode_and_multiline ../backend/tests/test_workspace_sync.py::test_dual_write_mode_keeps_annotations_isolated_from_content_outputs_with_unicode_and_multiline ../backend/tests/test_workspace_sync.py::test_mixed_legacy_and_v2_records_do_not_leak_annotation_quotes_into_feedback && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const timestamp=process.env.RELEASE_GATE_TIMESTAMP||'1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z';fs.mkdirSync('gate-results',{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync('gate-results/leak-gate.json', JSON.stringify({gate:'leak', leakCount:0, pass:true, timestamp}, null, 2));"
scripts.gate:parity: npm run e2e:parity && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const timestamp=process.env.RELEASE_GATE_TIMESTAMP||'1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z';const gate=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('test-results/parity-gate.json','utf8'));if(!(gate.pass===true&&gate.parityScore>=0.9)){process.exit(1)};fs.writeFileSync('test-results/parity-gate-check.json',JSON.stringify({gate:'parity', threshold:0.9, parityScore:gate.parityScore, pass:true, timestamp},null,2));"
scripts.gate:ai-confirm: RELEASE_GATE_CI=1 uv run pytest ../backend/tests/test_workspace_sync.py::test_ai_preview_requires_explicit_confirm_before_write ../backend/tests/test_workspace_sync.py::test_ai_preview_endpoint_throttles_abuse_path && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const timestamp=process.env.RELEASE_GATE_TIMESTAMP||'1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z';fs.mkdirSync('gate-results',{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync('gate-results/ai-confirm-gate.json',JSON.stringify({gate:'ai_confirm', invariant:'no_write_without_explicit_confirm', throttleAbusePath:true, pass:true, timestamp},null,2));"
scripts.gate:summary: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const timestamp=process.env.RELEASE_GATE_TIMESTAMP||'1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z';const read=(p)=>JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'));const leak=read('gate-results/leak-gate.json');const parity=read('test-results/parity-gate.json');const ai=read('gate-results/ai-confirm-gate.json');const summary={release:'vp-8i1', gates:{leak, parity:{threshold:parity.threshold, parityScore:parity.parityScore, pass:parity.pass, parityPassed:parity.parityPassed, totalCases:parity.totalCases}, aiConfirm:ai}, trends:{leakCount:leak.leakCount, parityScore:parity.parityScore, aiConfirmViolations:0}, pass:Boolean(leak.pass&&parity.pass&&ai.pass), generatedAt:timestamp};fs.mkdirSync('test-results',{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync('test-results/release-gates-vp-8i1.json',JSON.stringify(summary,null,2));if(!summary.pass){process.exit(1)};"
scripts.gate:ci: npm run gate:leak && npm run gate:parity && npm run gate:ai-confirm && npm run gate:summary
